docs: docs/en/browser-support.md and docs/ko/browser-support.md state these targets, and describe what each exception costs a reader

exceptions.reason: The focus ring around a field shell, a Rating star and a selectable DataTable. A field still shows focus through its border or fill and a DataTable through its active row, and a Rating falls back to :focus-within under @supports not selector(:has(*)).

Centres the box or icon beside a label on the label's first line, reserves the height a StreamingText holds before its first word lands, and sets a PromptInput's minimum and maximum rows. Without it the box sits at the top of the line, the reserved height is the line-height the browser computed rather than one line of this text, and the prompt field falls back to its rows attribute.
Registers the angle AnimateLighting animates. Without it the light stays in one place. Tailwind's own registered properties carry a fallback of their own.
Swaps ScrollArea's left and right edge fades in a right-to-left layout. Without it the fades are not swapped.
Hides the scrollbar of a strip that draws its own controls. The same rule hides it through ::-webkit-scrollbar in the browsers that lack this property.
A multiline TextField's resize handle, and WindowPane's. Safari on iOS and Firefox for Android draw no resize handle at all, so there is nothing to fall back to.
The pointer's shape over a control. Safari on iOS only draws a pointer on an iPad with a pointing device attached, and falls back to the default one for every keyword the data lists as unsupported.
The colour of selected text in a field. Safari on iOS keeps its own selection colour.
